data.preprocessing: same prepared MEG-MASC archive as the exp12 reference run
data.scaling: authors' per-recording scaling uses unlabeled data from the target recording

split.rule: test=fold[k], validation=fold[(k+1)%6], train=remaining 18 subjects; use both sessions when available
split.training_windows: canonical df_train27 excluding validation sound, training subjects only
split.validation_windows: canonical df_train27 validation sound, validation subjects only
split.calibration_budget: 0 labeled target windows; no target gradient updates

routing.shared_only: p_personal=0; all examples use a single trainable common matrix during training and evaluation

training.objective: upstream CLIPLoss with duplicate audio targets deduplicated, AdamW; skip batches with fewer than two distinct audio windows
training.checkpoint: maximum macro-subject validation Top-10, then Top-1, then earlier epoch

evaluation.rank: zero-based count of candidates with strictly larger cosine similarity
evaluation.aggregation: windows across available sessions per subject, then equal weight per subject
evaluation.partial_summary: include only matched folds with completed test evaluation
